basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and martial arts instructor living in Toronto, Canada. During the day, I work as an IT consultant, helping businesses optimize their tech stacks. In the evenings, I assist in teaching Taekwondo classes at our local studio. I’m always eager to integrate technology into physical training. On weekends, you’ll find me experimenting with card tricks or diving into the latest TikTok trends. I'm currently single and enjoy exploring new hobbies. I usually browse Reddit late at night, around 10 PM to 1 AM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology and have been working in the field for over 5 years. My martial arts journey began in childhood, and I've achieved a second-degree black belt in ITF Taekwondo. I often use self-learning platforms and online forums to keep up with the latest in tech and martial arts.
